name: 82443 · Thermopolis, WY
findings: ZIP 82443 (Thermopolis) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82443 (Thermopolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
